payload.question_text: A producer is reviewing a generated clip of a dog walking with a stick. Which checks should the producer make before delivery? Select all that apply.

options.text: Every frame has a class label.
options.rationale: Class labels identify image subjects. They do not ensure physical or temporal coherence in video.
options.better_fit: Use class labels when categorizing still images or frames.

feedback.intrinsic: The clip could still have impossible motion or event order.
feedback.instructional: Review physical behavior and temporal progression for coherent video.

options.text: The dog's feet stay on the ground.
options.rationale: Physical behavior must remain plausible in generated video. A walking dog's feet should contact the ground.

options.text: The walking unfolds logically over time.
options.rationale: Temporal progression requires a logical sequence of events. Walking should progress coherently across time.

options.text: The clip contains one high-resolution still frame.
options.rationale: A single sharp frame does not establish coherent movement. The producer must review change across time.
options.better_fit: Use this criterion when assessing a still image.

feedback.intrinsic: The clip could still contain inconsistent motion.
feedback.instructional: Video quality also depends on plausible physical behavior and logical temporal progression.
